tagline: Innovation for a Safer, Healthier, and More Sustainable World
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of Honeywell's growth, reflecting increasing demand for automation and digitalization in key industries. It is central to the company's transformation strategy.

kpis.name: Industrial Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from automation solutions for industries.
kpis.description: This segment includes products, software, and services that enhance productivity, safety, and efficiency in industrial environments. Following the 2026 reorganization, it includes smart energy, thermal solutions, process measurement and control, sensing and safety technologies, and productivity solutions.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by industrial digitalization.

kpis.name: Building Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from solutions for smart and sustainable buildings.
kpis.description: This segment offers technologies for energy management, security, fire protection, and facility management in commercial and residential buildings.
kpis.signal: Growing demand for safer and energy-efficient environments.

kpis.name: Aerospace Technologies Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from products and services for the aerospace industry.
kpis.description: This segment provides systems and components for commercial and military aircraft, as well as defense solutions.
kpis.signal: Recovery and growth in the global aviation sector.

kpis.name: Process Automation and Technology Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the new segment created in 2026 combining Honeywell's and UOP's process solutions.
kpis.description: This newly formed segment includes core process solutions from Honeywell Process Solutions and UOP, previously reported in Industrial Automation and Energy and Sustainability Solutions respectively.
kpis.signal: Segment creation following strategic reorganization effective Q1 2026.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates the company's ability to profitably produce its goods and services.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of profitability and operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the profitability of the company's core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational profitability and managerial efficiency.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue dedicated to research and development.
kpis.description: R&D expenditures are critical for developing new technologies and improving existing products.
kpis.signal: Commitment to innovation to maintain competitive advantage.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets for the acquisition or improvement of long-term assets.
kpis.description: CAPEX includes spending on plants, equipment, and other physical assets necessary for operations.
kpis.signal: Investment in production capacity to support future growth.

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividends per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of $1.19 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $2.976 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 62.9% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last seven reported fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $37.442 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years 10-K.
kpis.signal: Net income of $4.729 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Industrial Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from automation solutions for industries.
kpis.description: This segment includes products, software, and services that enhance productivity, safety, and efficiency in industrial environments. Following the 2026 reorganization, it includes smart energy, thermal solutions, process measurement and control, sensing and safety technologies, and productivity solutions.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by industrial digitalization.
